The CJP burst onto the political scene in May, mobilising thousands of young people to protest against exam paper leaks, unemployment and the high cost of living. Weeks later, the education minister resigned.

Opposition parties and the CJP accuse India's electoral body of manipulating voter lists in favour of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s governing Bharatiya Janata Party. The commission denies any wrongdoing. It says it was removing deceased, duplicate and ineligible voters.

author: Al Jazeera English
description: Five Palestinians, including four children, have been killed after a sand embankment collapsed onto tents sheltering displaced families in Deir el-Balah, central Gaza, amid heavy rainfall. Several people are believed to remain trapped beneath the sand, while residents have been forced to search for survivors using their bare hands because rescue equipment and emergency services cannot reach everyone. The collapse has further exposed the dangers facing displaced families living in makeshift tents on unstable ground, with flooding and damaged buildings adding to the humanitarian crisis. As the rainy and winter seasons approach, families fear further collapses and worsening conditions. Humanitarian organisations have repeatedly called for the entry of proper tents, mobile homes and other essential supplies, which were included in the first phase of the ceasefire agreement. title: Gaza sand embankment collapses onto tents, killing five Palestinians, including four children
